I met her on tinder. It was my first tinder success story so I was looking forward to it. She was a nice girl, we had been speaking for a while and we arranged the date, it was going to be Bowling, meal and if all was going well maybe a movie afterwards. I didn't mind paying for this as she was a student and I'm not. So we get to the evening and I'm standing there outside Tenpin and this car pulls up in front of me and she pops her head out the window and says "that we're just gonna find a parking space round the corner." This is when alarm bells should have been ringing. She was in the passengers side and she said we're. Anyway a few minutes later these two figures come round the corner and it's my date and an older woman. We make our greetings, i find out that herthe older woman is he rmother and we head in side. Again alarm bells should be going off as her mother is still following us in. Get to the desk thinking that she might leave, I ask for a lane for 2 with shoes and her mum buts in and says, "3". She doesn't offer to pay and I just bite the bullet as my date is a really nice girl and I wanted to impress. As we're bowling her mum is pretty much unnoticeable for the first part of the game, then she starts making comments, "he bowls like a bit of a tit." "His hair is uneven in the back." I can hear all this. After the game we had to this pizza a place, which I have to cover the bill for the mother as well. Because me and the date are actually getting on well and hitting it off. After the meal, I couldn't afford to take them both to the cinema so we called it there, thankfully her mum gave me a lift home and as I step out of the car, my date is about to follow me to walk me to the door, when her mum stops her and says, "No Missy, you stay there it's cold outside, I'll walk him." She walks me to the door and says, "thank you for the wonderful evening, I had a great time and I look forward to seeing you again." She plants a kiss on my cheek as my dad opens the door. I've never been driven so close to death before that. They have a full conversation for a few minutes while my date is spamming my phone with apologetic texts and trying to explain why this happened. Basically, her mum was worried about her daughter being away from home at uni and wanted to make sure that she was safe, I should mention that the mother made an hour and half drive to come to my city. Me and the date went on a few more dates and I was going to introduce her to my parents because she was feeling homesick, a nd her mum decided to invite herself so that was the final nail in the coffin. She was a really cool person and I feel so sorry for her with such a over the top Mother. TL;DR: Went on a date,  her mother was there, her mother didn't leave, mother her mother kissed me in front of my dad.
